title: The Archivist's Desk
offer: Every festival, the factions come begging for the villagers' data. My job is to remember WHY each scrap was given — and refuse every clever excuse to use it otherwise. Sit. Take the queue. I'll watch.
debrief: Purpose limitation: match the use to why the data was given. Compatible may pass; incompatible must ask afresh; when in doubt, condition it.

steps.objective: Judge the faction requests at the Archivist's Desk
